about: Second batch of G2s substance-name labels (2026-09-16). Pool: every substance name in the ONSSA cache, the Türkiye/Egypt register cache and the RASFF export that the deterministic resolver (commit 7c2bf8c) cannot map, minus the 12 seed names. Labelled by hand against the EU snapshot 2026-09-13 (names checked to exist). eval/build_g2s.py assigns 10 of these to the held-out split with a fixed seed. Rule: the deterministic resolver (aliases, endings) must not be extended using names from this batch.

excluded.pesticide residues: RASFF data artifact, not a substance
excluded.Esters méthyliques d'acides gras: ambiguous: adjuvant methyl esters, or the EU-registered 'Fatty acids C8-C10 methyl esters'; truth not decidable from the label name
